## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] Avro record schema resolution matches fields by name; when a reader expects a field absent from the writer schema it uses the reader default, or signals an error if there is no default. Salesforce’s old-schema compatibility is conditional on these resolution rules. (high confidence) — https://avro.apache.org/docs/1.12.0/specification/ · keywords: Salesforce CDC Avro schemas and changed-field interpretation · also: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/pub-sub-api/references/methods/getschema-rpc.html

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] Cache schemas instead of calling GetSchema for every RPC; retrieve a new schema when the received schema ID changes after a definition change. (low confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/pub-sub-api/references/methods/getschema-rpc.html · keywords: Salesforce CDC Avro schemas and changed-field interpretation

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Pub/Sub CDC delivers raw Avro payloads; decode the change-header bitmaps against the event schema before using their field names. (high confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/pub-sub-api/guide/event-deserialization-considerations.html · keywords: Salesforce CDC Avro schemas and changed-field interpretation · also: https://github.com/forcedotcom/pub-sub-api/blob/main/python/util/ChangeEventHeaderUtility.py
- [statement] For a received event, get the schema ID from the event message in FetchResponse, retrieve that schema with GetSchema, and use it to deserialize the payload. (low confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/pub-sub-api/references/methods/getschema-rpc.html · keywords: Salesforce CDC Avro schemas and changed-field interpretation
- [statement] An empty value in an UPDATE payload does not prove a field was cleared: unchanged fields also carry empty values. Decode changedFields and nulledFields to distinguish these cases. (high confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/pub-sub-api/guide/event-deserialization-considerations.html · keywords: Salesforce CDC Avro schemas and changed-field interpretation · also: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/change-data-capture/guide/cdc-event-fields-body.html
- [statement] changedFields includes fields explicitly set to null; nulledFields isolates fields cleared to null. (high confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/change-data-capture/guide/cdc-event-fields-body.html · keywords: Salesforce CDC Avro schemas and changed-field interpretation · also: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/pub-sub-api/guide/event-deserialization-considerations.html
- [statement] changedFields describes updates and is empty for other operations, including creation; a CREATE body still includes all record and system fields, even empty ones. (high confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/change-data-capture/guide/cdc-event-fields-header.html · keywords: Salesforce CDC Avro schemas and changed-field interpretation · also: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/change-data-capture/guide/cdc-event-fields-body.html
- [statement] diffFields identifies values delivered as a diff; the CDC header reference specifies a unified diff for large text values, so these payload values need diff interpretation. (high confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/pub-sub-api/guide/event-deserialization-considerations.html · keywords: Salesforce CDC Avro schemas and changed-field interpretation · also: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/change-data-capture/guide/cdc-event-fields-header.html
- [statement] The Python sample resolves compound-field bitmap entries by splitting the parent position from the child bitmap, selecting that parent’s nested schema, and returning dotted parent and child field names. (low confidence) — https://github.com/forcedotcom/pub-sub-api/blob/main/python/util/ChangeEventHeaderUtility.py · keywords: Salesforce CDC Avro schemas and changed-field interpretation
- [statement] Field presence alone does not prove a change: Salesforce’s enriched-event example includes values for unchanged enriched fields; changedFields identifies the actual changes. (low confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/change-data-capture/guide/cdc-enrich-event-example.html · keywords: Salesforce CDC Avro schemas and changed-field interpretation

## Research summary — Salesforce CDC Avro schemas and changed-field interpretation

Salesforce CDC payloads require two interpretations: Avro deserialization with the received event’s schema, and change-header bitmap decoding. An UPDATE can include empty values for unchanged fields as well as fields cleared to null. changedFields and nulledFields distinguish those cases. Compound fields require nested bitmap handling, and diffFields identifies values delivered as diffs. These semantics matter when a Case alert depends on a specific field change. Schema caching must follow schema IDs, and compatibility depends on Avro resolution rules.
